name: _chrome.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  app/_chrome.scss — shell chrome: the fixed <app-nav> mount point, the
//  routed-view wrapper, and the open/closed display rules for the
//  preferences + language dialogs that layer above the menu overlay.
//  Imported by app.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── App shell nav bar ─ fixed across the top; --on-dark variant inverts to light text over dark sections (contact band).
app-nav {
  display: block;
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  z-index: 1000;
  pointer-events: none;
}

[data-app-wrapper] {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  background: transparent;
}

preferences-modal:not([open]):not(.is-open),
lang-dialog:not([open]):not(.is-open) {
  display: none;
}

preferences-modal[open],
preferences-modal.is-open,
lang-dialog[open],
lang-dialog.is-open {
  display: block;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100vw;
  height: 100vh;
  height: 100dvh;
  z-index: 10000;
  pointer-events: auto;
}
